signals.signal: NLB Group Annual Report 2025 states that in Payments during 2025 'the cash repricing concept was approved, and the migration of VISA Business cards was successfully completed. Tenders for ATM and Cash Deposit Machines (CDS) were finalised.' The Group-level ATM and cash-deposit-machine procurement was therefore already COMPLETED in 2025, before the Investor Day commitment was made public.
signals.source_name: NLB Group Annual Report 2025 (PDF, via NLB Financial Reports)
signals.implies: Award already made across the 6-7 market Group footprint. Printec should establish the winning OEM/integrator and target the rollout, spare parts, cash-management software, multivendor ATM software layer and managed services that sit around it, plus any lots not covered.
signals.likelihood: Certain that tenders closed; rollout runs 2026-2027
signals.followup: Identify winning vendor(s), per-country lot split and unit volumes; probe for unawarded software/services lots

signals.signal: Investor Day 'Payments Transformation and Technology' deck (07/05/2026) sets out the cash-transition lever in detail: 'ATM & CDS network upgrade at Group level driving cash out of branches - Moving cash transactions from branches to ATM & CDS. Upgraded ATMs and expanded CDS enable seamless deposits with instant visibility. ATM withdrawals flat YoY as customers shift digital.' Cash transactions in branches (retail) fell from 32% (2023) to 15.1% (YE25) to 13.5% (March 2026), against a <10% 2030 target.
signals.source_name: NLB Investor Day 2026 - Payments Transformation and Technology (PDF)
signals.implies: Explicit deposit-automation programme: cash recyclers/CDS, cash-forecasting and cash-management optimisation software, and end-to-end managed services. 'Instant visibility' implies real-time deposit credit integration work.
signals.followup: Country split and unit count of the CDS expansion

signals.signal: NLB d.d. introduced its FIRST Cash Deposit System (CDS) machine in Slovenia in 2025, aimed at legal entities/business clients, 'with additional units planned to be located across Slovenia'.
signals.source_name: NLB Group Annual Report 2025 (PDF, via NLB Financial Reports)
signals.implies: Greenfield business cash-deposit estate in Slovenia from a base of one unit - direct fit for Printec cash automation/recyclers, note/coin validation, and retail cash-management services for SME merchants.
signals.followup: Confirm planned CDS unit count and the OEM of the first unit

signals.signal: Accessibility retrofit programme: at YE2025, 58 NLB ATMs in Slovenia supported voice-guided transactions for blind and partially sighted customers, 'with 26 more to be upgraded by Q1 2026'. NLB commits to equip ALL ATMs with accessibility features by 2030, under the EU digital accessibility directive effective since June 2025. Hearing-loop devices were installed in all NLB branches.
signals.source_name: NLB Group Annual Report 2025 (PDF, via NLB Financial Reports)
signals.implies: Regulation-driven, fleet-wide ATM upgrade or replacement running to 2030 - audio/accessibility hardware kits, ATM application software (voice guidance), and nationwide field-service execution.
signals.followup: Whether NLB delivers this by retrofit or by accelerating hardware replacement; how many of the ~539 Slovenian ATMs remain non-compliant

signals.signal: Regulator statistical series 'Stevilo terminalov, ki jih zagotovijo rezidenti' (PX-Axis, last updated 18/06/2026) gives the national estate: total ATMs 1,330 at 2026Q1, down from 1,346 (2025Q4), 1,374 (2024Q4) and 1,400 (2023Q4); ATMs accepting contactless transactions 993 at 2026Q1; POS terminals 46,659 at 2026Q1 (46,330 at 2025Q4, 47,235 at 2024Q4). Note the series' 'ATMs with credit-transfer function' value drops implausibly from 917 to 100 between 2025Q4 and 2026Q1 and looks like a reporting artefact - do not rely on it.
signals.source_name: Banka Slovenije PX statistical database - PTNS.PX (terminals provided by residents)
signals.implies: Roughly 337 of 1,330 Slovenian ATMs (about 25%) still do not accept contactless - a hard, quantified replacement/upgrade addressable base for Printec ATM and self-service. The gently shrinking ATM base plus a flat-to-growing POS base confirms consolidation into fewer, richer (deposit/recycling) devices rather than pure withdrawal units.
signals.followup: Break the 337 non-contactless units down by owning bank

signals.signal: NLB's voluntary public takeover offer for Addiko Bank AG was materially restructured: offer price EUR 37.00 per share cum dividend, all cash; the Austrian Takeover Commission approved on 15/07/2026 an amendment cutting NLB's minimum acceptance threshold to 50% plus one share (9,750,001 Addiko shares) and extending the acceptance period to Wednesday 29/07/2026 17:00 CET. RBI's competing offer (EUR 26.50) had reached acceptances for 10,703,509 shares (55.5%) as of 20/07/2026, above its own >55% threshold; RBI acceptances could be revoked in favour of NLB until 23/07/2026 17:00 CET. EBRD (8.4%), Brandes (5.07%), Wellington (5.7%) and Addiko Supervisory Board Deputy Chairman Johannes Proksch committed to NLB. NLB has merger clearance in Serbia, Austria and North Macedonia. As of 31/07/2026 no final result had been published.
signals.source_name: NLB Group - Addiko Takeover Offer page; NLB press release 20/07/2026
signals.implies: Whoever wins sets the technology path for Addiko's ~6-market SEE network including Addiko Bank d.d. Ljubljana. An NLB win would fold Addiko into the just-tendered NLB ATM/CDS programme and NLB's Group payments stack (opportunity to extend the same estate); an RBI win pulls it toward RBI group standards. Either way a post-merger fleet/estate harmonisation project follows.
signals.followup: Pull the final acceptance announcement (NLB investor news / takeover.at / Addiko) and then the Addiko Slovenia ATM+POS estate count

signals.signal: OTP Group 1Q2026 report: OTP banka Slovenia had 70 branches, 389 ATMs and 12,830 POS terminals at 31/03/2026, down from 74 branches, 390 ATMs and 13,001 POS at 31/12/2025 (headcount 2,086, -30 q-o-q). Total assets EUR 15.6bn, second-largest bank in Slovenia, 26.8% market share; loan market shares consumer 31%, corporate 24.8%, mortgage 25.9%. A EUR 14.5m provision was booked in 1Q2026 after a final Croatian second-instance ruling on 16/04/2026 in a case predating the NKBM acquisition.
signals.source_name: OTP Bank Plc - Summary of the First Quarter 2026 Results (PDF)
signals.implies: A ~12,800-terminal acquiring POS estate plus a 389-unit ATM fleet in a market where OTP is consolidating branches (-4 in one quarter) - classic conditions for shifting cash and service transactions onto self-service and for a POS/TMS refresh. Printec POS/acquiring, terminal management, ATM and managed services all in scope.
signals.followup: Identify the OEM of the 389 ATMs and the POS/TMS incumbent post NKBM+SKB merger; confirm at OTP 1H2026 (due ~August 2026)

signals.signal: OTP banka SI published branch-network consolidation notices ('Zdruzevanje bliznjih poslovalnic poslovne mreze OTP banke') on 16/02/2026 and 23/03/2026, and made the mobile token mandatory from March 2026 ('Obvezna uvedba mobilnega zetona od marca 2026').
signals.implies: Branch closures displace cash transactions onto the ATM fleet, strengthening the case for deposit/recycling upgrades. Mandatory mobile token = strong-authentication estate refresh, adjacent to Printec digital onboarding/eKYC and HSM/security.
signals.followup: How many branches closed and whether ATMs were retained at closed sites

signals.signal: Intesa Sanpaolo Bank Slovenia Annual Report 2025 (English): 'In 2025, the Bank carried out a significant part of the ATM network upgrade. Most ATMs now support contactless transactions, while ATMs located in branches also allow cash deposits and offer an enhanced level of security. The Bank also introduced a fee for ATM withdrawals for cardholders of foreign issuers.' 'Renewal and modernisation of the ATM network' remains on the 2026 ICT development list alongside 'modernising instant payment infrastructure and processes' and DORA ICT upgrades. The Bank says it is 'ready to play an active role in the new Group Business Plan for 2026-2029, leveraging the extension of the Isytech platform... and improving the distribution footprint at a national level.' A new cashless advisory branch opened at BTC Ljubljana in November 2025. 717 employees at 31/12/2025.
signals.implies: The remaining tranche of the ATM renewal is explicitly a 2026 item, and 'improving the distribution footprint' plus cashless branches means in-branch deposit automation. Isytech extension is the same Group platform running at VUB SK - the integration path is Group-set, so Printec's realistic entry is hardware, cash automation and field/managed services rather than the core.
signals.followup: Intesa SI ATM unit count and OEM; scope of the 2026 renewal tranche

signals.signal: Intesa SI ran repeated overnight system-upgrade windows through 2026 that explicitly took 'ATMs and POS terminals' out of service, including 18/06/2026 and 25/06/2026 (01:00-12:00), 23-24/07/2026 and 29-30/07/2026, alongside instant payment processing and the PSD2 system. In 2025 the Bank also implemented a Group-level real-time fraud-prevention solution for retail clients and expanded MFA to all users and key systems.
signals.source_name: Intesa Sanpaolo Bank Slovenia - Upgrade notices (Obvestila o nadgradnjah)
signals.implies: A sustained, high-cadence card/ATM/POS platform migration is under way in 2026 - consistent with the Isytech extension. Windows that simultaneously drop ATM, POS, instant payments and PSD2 indicate authorisation-layer work. Adjacent Printec plays: transaction monitoring, HSM/security, and managed services to absorb the operational load.
signals.followup: Confirm whether these windows are the ATM renewal or a core authorisation migration

signals.signal: Bankart is 100% bank-owned: NLB 46.03%, OTP banka d.d. 43.06%, Banka Intesa Sanpaolo 7.25%, UniCredit Banka Slovenija 2.24%, Dezelna banka Slovenije 1.42% (NLB's founding agreement caps any non-NLB shareholder at 25%, which OTP now exceeds following the Abanka/Nova KBM/SKB mergers). Bankart employs 'more than 250' specialists, serves six countries, processes >45 million transactions per month, and manages the member banks' ATM and POS terminal networks including authorisation-parameter management and Visa/Mastercard mandate compliance. Its open banking platform (built with IBM Business Partner SRC sistemske integracije, on IBM API Connect and Red Hat OpenShift) is used by 11 of Slovenia's 15 banks. The BASELINE claim that Bankart's authorisation-system replacement completes end-2026 could NOT be re-verified from any primary source this run.
signals.source_name: Bankart - Company page; NLB Group Annual Report 2025; IBM case study 'Bankart'
signals.implies: Bankart is the single chokepoint for ATM/POS driving, TMS and authorisation across most of Slovenia - any Printec ATM or POS estate win in Slovenia is mediated by Bankart certification. The OTP 43.06% stake sitting above the 25% founding cap is a governance stress point worth watching. SRC sistemske integracije is the named local integrator competitor.
signals.followup: OPERATOR: pull Bankart d.o.o. annual report from AJPES to confirm or kill the end-2026 authorisation-system replacement and get ATM/POS counts

signals.signal: Merchant acquiring detail from the Investor Day Payments deck: 20,000 acquiring merchants; acquiring payments partners grew from 5 (YE2023) to 11 (YE2025) against a >20 target for 2030; addressable regional POS transaction pool >EUR 120bn with 64-80%+ still cash; acquiring payments estimated CAGR approx. 11-20% 2026-2030. Named initiatives: 'Digital merchant onboarding live (SLO & SRB)', 'Additional partnerships & E2E POS-ECR integration... digital tips, soft POS and others', and a 'New Merchant Portal' live in Slovenia with 'more countries this year' plus a merchant Cash Advance product next.
signals.source_name: NLB Investor Day 2026 - Payments Transformation and Technology (PDF)
signals.implies: Directly maps to Printec POS/acquiring (terminal estate, Android POS, softPOS), POS-to-ECR/cash-register integration - which is exactly Printec's Slovak eKasa capability - and digital onboarding/eKYC for merchant acquisition. Merchant portal and analytics are a value-added services attach.
signals.followup: Who supplies NLB's merchant terminals and TMS today; scope of the E2E POS-ECR integration work

signals.signal: Cards/tokenisation and security metrics from the Investor Day Payments deck: tokenised card transactions rose from 2.5% (2023) to 13.8% (YE2025) to 18.3% (March 2026) against a >25% 2030 target; NLB Pay mobile wallet penetration 25.9% vs a >40% 2030 target, flagged '!Focus' (i.e. behind plan); card issuing net non-interest income improved 78% YE25 vs YE23; average value spent per card +30%. Technology slide states 'AI at scale: AML, retail credit risk, chatbots', '+120 RPAs in production across the Group', '>99.5% run availability across core systems' and '>60% cloud adoption from 20%' by 2030.
signals.source_name: NLB Investor Day 2026 - Payments Transformation and Technology (PDF)
signals.implies: Tokenisation growth plus a wallet target NLB is behind on drives HSM/key-management and token-service capacity. 'AI at scale: AML' is an explicit, board-level AML/transaction-monitoring modernisation lane for Printec's AML/compliance and transaction-monitoring products.
signals.followup: Current AML/transaction-monitoring vendor at NLB Group and whether the AI-AML work is in-house or sourced

signals.signal: The Investor Day Payments deck states the Strategy 2030 investment envelope as 'EUR 160-200 m', while NLB's public Strategy 2030 web page states 'EUR 170-200 million investment over five years' for the digital business model transition. Payments revenue EUR 207m (FY2023) to EUR 236.5m (FY2025) to >EUR 320m (FY2030 target, +6% CAGR); retail revenue EUR 712m (2023) to EUR 873m (2025) to >EUR 1.3bn (2030); digital penetration 50.4% (2023), 61.8% (2025), 72.6% (2028 plan), >80% (2030); branch FTE -7.0% YE25 vs YE24; NLB H1 2026 results are due 06/08/2026.
signals.source_name: NLB Investor Day 2026 Payments deck; NLB Strategy 2030 page; NLB Financial Calendar
signals.implies: Sizes the wallet: a EUR 160-200m five-year technology envelope with an explicit ATM/CDS line inside it. The 160 vs 170 lower-bound discrepancy between deck and website should be resolved before it is quoted to a customer. Branch FTE falling 7% in a year is the operational driver behind the self-service push.
signals.followup: Reconcile the EUR 160m vs 170m lower bound; re-read the H1 2026 interim report on 06/08/2026 for ATM/CDS rollout progress

signals.signal: Investor Day Payments deck lists 'Cash-at-POS rollout for improved convenience' as a named cash-transition initiative: 'Cash withdrawals move from branches to merchant tills - lowering cost-to-serve and improving customer service through longer hours and denser coverage, while keeping NLB central to cash flows.' Separately, SEPA expansion completed to Skopje and Podgorica (NLB banks in SEPA went 1 in 2023 to 4 in 2026, incl. processing for the central bank of North Macedonia), with Serbia to follow in May 2026, and real-time remittances via Visa Direct and Mastercard MoneySend are in launch.
signals.source_name: NLB Investor Day 2026 - Payments Transformation and Technology (PDF)
signals.implies: Cash-at-POS requires terminal application changes, cash-limit/authorisation logic and merchant cash-management across the acquiring estate - a POS software and services opportunity that runs in parallel with, not instead of, the ATM/CDS build.
signals.followup: Which markets get cash-at-POS first and on whose terminal software

coverage_notes: Fresh full run (no checkpoint existed). Primary-source first. Opened and text-extracted locally: NLB Investor Day 2026 decks (PAYMENTS, RETAIL, CEO, CFO PDFs, 07/05/2026), NLB Group Annual Report 2025, NLB Interim Report Q1 2026, NLB Strategy 2030 page, NLB Financial Calendar, NLB Addiko Takeover Offer page and press release 20/07/2026, Addiko takeover-offer page, OTP Bank Plc 1Q2026 results report (Slovenia section and network table), OTP banka d.d. Slovenia news page, Intesa Sanpaolo Bank Slovenia Annual Report 2025 (EN PDF) and its 2026 upgrade-notice log, Bankart company/acquiring/careers pages, IBM Bankart case study, and the Bank of Slovenia PX statistical database file PTNS.PX (terminals provided by residents, updated 18/06/2026). Searched in English and Slovenian across regulator (bsi.si, px.bsi.si), open-data (podatki.gov.si/OPSI), procurement (enarocanje.si, ejn.gov.si), takeover-register (takeover.at) and press entry points. NEW vs baseline: (1) the NLB ATM/CDS tenders were already FINALISED in 2025 per the Annual Report - the baseline treated this as a forward commitment; (2) NLB's first CDS machine in Slovenia and planned expansion; (3) the fleet-wide accessibility retrofit obligation to 2030; (4) hard regulator fleet data - 1,330 ATMs / 993 contactless / 46,659 POS at 2026Q1; (5) the Addiko bid restructured to EUR 37.00 and a 50%+1 threshold with a 29/07/2026 close (baseline had EUR 29.00 and >55%); (6) OTP SI POS estate of 12,830 terminals, never previously captured; (7) Intesa SI Isytech extension under the 2026-2029 Group Business Plan plus an observed 2026 cadence of ATM/POS/PSD2 upgrade windows. GENUINE GAPS: (a) the Bankart end-2026 authorisation-system replacement could not be re-verified from any primary source and is flagged unverified, not carried as fact; (b) Bankart's 1,814-ATM / 55,000-POS figures from the baseline could not be re-sourced - Bankart publishes no annual report or metrics on its website; (c) no ATM/CDS vendor is named anywhere in NLB's disclosures, so the winning OEM for the finalised tender remains unidentified (standing task); (d) Addiko Bank d.d. Ljubljana's own ATM/POS estate could not be sized this run and the takeover outcome was not yet public at 31/07/2026; (e) NLB H1 2026 results were not yet published (due 06/08/2026), so all NLB financials here are Q1 2026 or FY2025.
access_issues: ibm.com/case-studies/bankart returned HTTP 403 to the fetch tool; recovered by re-requesting the same URL with a desktop Chrome User-Agent via curl and stripping the HTML locally (HTTP 200). enarocanje.si/Obrazci query URL returned 404 and two guessed bsi.si statistics paths returned 404; routed instead to the OPSI open-data catalogue entry and then to the raw PX-Axis file at px.bsi.si, which succeeded. pdftotext is not installed in this environment - all PDFs were extracted with Python pdfminer instead. Slovenian public procurement portals carry no relevant bank ATM/POS notices, which is expected: NLB, OTP SI, Intesa SI and Bankart are not contracting authorities under the public procurement act for this spend, so no tender records exist to mine. No source was silently dropped.
operator_requests: 1) Bankart d.o.o. annual report / financial statements from AJPES (https://www.ajpes.si) - needed to confirm or kill the 'authorisation-system replacement completing end-2026' claim and to re-source the 1,814 ATM / 55,000 POS estate figures. Bankart publishes nothing itself. 2) NLB Group Annual Report 2025 full PDF and the H1 2026 interim report when published on 06/08/2026 - check the Payments section for the ATM/CDS rollout vendor and unit counts. 3) The final Addiko takeover acceptance announcements (NLB investor news, takeover.at, addiko.com) published after 29/07/2026 - not yet indexed as of 31/07/2026.
